aggregation_semantics.ADE: micro mean over every available matched actor-horizon error
aggregation_semantics.FDE: micro mean of evaluator-defined final error, one per matched track
aggregation_semantics.class_slices: truth class; matched forecast errors plus class-specific recall and endpoint miss
aggregation_semantics.horizon_endpoint_miss: sum endpoint misses / sum eligible truth tracks
aggregation_semantics.reconstruction: micro TP/FP/FN pooled over the 120 frozen scenarios; for the primary tracks_to_predict view, predictions matched to current-valid real non-target actors are ignored rather than counted as false positives

primary_evaluation.target_policy: WOMD tracks_to_predict; evaluator metadata only; accessed after prediction; current-valid real non-target actors are evaluator-ignored rather than counted as false predictions
